"""Telemetry metric streaming normalizer."""
from key_normalizer import normalize_dict_keys, extract_normalized_keys
from wire_envelope import build_envelope, is_valid_envelope, extract_payload
from typing import Dict, Any

def prepare_metric_packet(data: Dict[str, Any], epoch_ms: int, service_name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Prepare telemetry metric packet for distribution to event stream."""
    return build_envelope(service_name, epoch_ms, normalize_dict_keys(data))

def publish_stream_packet(data: Dict[str, Any], epoch_ms: int, service_name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    pkt = prepare_metric_packet(data, epoch_ms, service_name)
    if not is_valid_envelope(pkt):
        return None
    return pkt
=== END ===

=== FILE: tests/test_telemetry_stream.py ===
from telemetry_stream import prepare_metric_packet, publish_stream_packet

def test_nominal_metric_packet():
    raw = {"val": 1.0}
    service_name = "test_service"
    pkt = prepare_metric_packet(raw, 200, service_name)
    expected_pkt = {
        "_v": 2,
        "_ts": 200,
        "_src": service_name,
        "payload": {"val": 1.0}
    }
    assert isinstance(pkt, dict)
    assert publish_stream_packet(raw, 200, service_name) == expected_pkt
=== END ===

=== FILE: tests/test_telemetry_cases.py ===
from telemetry_stream import prepare_metric_packet, publish_stream_packet

def test_service_execution():
    service_name = "test_service"
    res = prepare_metric_packet({"metricName": "cpu_util", "hostId": "srv-1"}, 1700000002, service_name)
    assert res is not None
    assert res.get("_v") == 2
    assert res.get("_ts") == 1700000002
    assert res.get("_src") == service_name
    payload = res.get("payload")
    assert payload is not None
    assert payload.get("metric_name") == "cpu_util"
    assert payload.get("host_id") == "srv-1"
=== END ===
